# Transferable_Lightweight_Neuromorphic

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A methodology for compressing and transferring neuromorphic models across hardware platforms while preserving functional accuracy and low resource footprint. Critical for deploying iNEST solutions on edge devices with limited memory and power, enabling practical in-network neuromorphic inference.
